home.view.blockedBudget: Autonomous needs a budget cap: set one in Settings.
home.view.agentProfileHelp: Run the chat as one of your agents: its instructions, its model unless you pick one, and only its tools. Manage them in Workspace settings → Agents.
home.workspace.homeWarning: That's your whole home folder. Pick a single project folder so the agent stays inside it.
home.readiness.label: Setup check
home.readiness.cliFix: Install it in your terminal, then open a new terminal window:
home.readiness.signInFix: Sign in yourself in your terminal. AgentChainer never handles your login:
home.readiness.summary: · Claude CLI {{claude}} · signed in with {{auth}} · git {{git}}
home.readiness.title: Set up Claude
home.readiness.guide: Step-by-step guide for each OS: Help → Getting Started. Claude installed somewhere unusual? Set the Claude CLI path in Settings.
home.settings.title: Settings
home.settings.exported: Saved to {{path}}. Secrets, emails and your home folder are masked; check before sharing.
home.settings.restartBody: AgentChainer restarts in {{language}}. Running sessions stop; you can resume them. Choose Cancel to switch the next time it starts.
home.settings.showThinking: Show summaries of Claude's thinking <muted>(no extra cost)</muted>
home.settings.autoApply: Apply safe setup automatically before a new session
home.settings.autoApplyHelp: Only reviewed first-party and official catalog items, plus fixes that only add lines (env rules in .gitignore, importing AGENTS.md). Never generators, git changes, or vendor and community items. What was applied shows in the session, and Workspace settings → History can roll it back.
home.settings.tasksPreviewHelp: Adds New task ({{keys}}): Claude drafts a contract for the work, triage proposes a tier, and you approve both before it runs. Your project's own checks then verify the result.
home.settings.budgetHelp: Leave empty for no cap. The Autonomous profile needs one. Applies to sessions started after saving.
home.settings.editorHelp: Editors other than the system default need their command-line launcher.
home.settings.claudePathHelp: Leave empty to find it automatically. Changing it restarts the agent runtime.
home.settings.agentPathHelp: For task steps that run on it. Leave empty to find it automatically. Changing it restarts the agent runtime.
home.settings.diagnosticsHelp: Diagnostics hold versions, settings, the setup check and recent logs, for bug reports. No credentials or account details. AgentChainer sends no telemetry; see the <link>privacy statement</link>.
home.update.title: Check for updates
home.update.installFailed: The update couldn't be installed: {{error}}. Restart AgentChainer to continue.
home.update.notSetUp: Updates aren't set up in this build.
home.update.notSetUpHelp: Development builds, and builds made without the release key, can't check for updates. New versions are on the <link>releases page</link>.
home.update.installHelp: Installing stops running agents and closes terminals. Resume your sessions from the sidebar after the restart.
home.update.installing: Installing… AgentChainer restarts when it's done.
home.settings.taskDefaultsHelp: How every workspace's tasks run unless the task or the workspace chooses otherwise. A workspace can set its own in Workspace settings → Workflows.
home.welcome.title: AgentChainer
home.welcome.subtitle: Agents that make your repo ready and keep their work checked.
home.welcome.noRecent: Folders you open show up here.
home.newSession.title: New session
home.newSession.description: Pick the folder the agent works in, and how much it may do on its own.
home.newSession.folderHelp: The agent works here. In Safe and Standard, an edit outside it waits for your approval.
home.newSession.codexHelp: Your own Codex CLI, signed in by you. Its edits and commands go through the guard and your approvals, like Claude's. No plan mode, and no rewind.
home.newSession.codexModel: Codex's default (pick another in the chat)
home.newSession.agyHelp: Your own Antigravity CLI, signed in by you. It edits files but runs no commands, and never asks first: Standard edits, Plan only reads. A message sent while it works waits for the next turn. The chat can't be reopened after the app restarts.
home.agents.intro: The coding agents this computer has. You install them and sign in from your own terminal: AgentChainer never signs in for you.
home.agents.claudeUse: Chats, every task step by default, and the app's own drafting and reviews.
home.agents.codexUse: Chats, and any task step you give it.
home.agents.agyUse: Chats, and task steps you give it. It edits files but runs no commands.
home.agents.toInstall: To use it, install it in a terminal:
home.agents.toSignIn: Sign in from your own terminal, then Check again:
home.agents.toSignInAgy: Run it once in your own terminal and sign in when it asks, then Check again:
home.agents.pathPlaceholder: Empty: the one found on your PATH
home.newSession.noFolderHint: Pick a recent one, browse to one, or make a new one.
home.newSession.newFolderGitHint: (tasks and the Changes panel need one)
home.newSession.agentSignIn: Sign in from your terminal first
